title: Gangs Attack Multinational Force in Haiti
gist: Podcast notes: gangs attacked the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force in Haiti, four Salvadoran members are missing, and the episode discusses gang territorial control, possible election delays and US deportations of Haitians.

insights.claim: Gangs in Haiti attacked members of the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force, highlighting the challenges facing multinational security efforts, and four El Salvadoran members of the force are missing after the attack.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Casualties and missing troops could erode contributor countries' willingness to stay.
insights.locator: This week, gangs in Haiti attacked

insights.claim: The episode discusses the gangs' extensive control of territory and whether upcoming Haitian elections are likely to be postponed.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Election slippage would prolong instability and migration pressure.

insights.claim: The Trump administration's efforts to deport Haitians from the United States are flagged as a potential factor for Haiti's situation.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Returns of deportees could add strain to Haiti's weak institutions.
insights.locator: the potential impact of the Trump administration
